label: Actual-root favourings are good-general, from nonlimitation and the value standard
meaning: Fix an actual root r at w and a favouring determination favours phi of r. Actual roots have no represented limiting principle (its distinct simply prior being is the shared CausalityFrame's PriorSimply, PRIOR_1), so by the RootPurity bridge every real determination of r is pure, favours phi among them. The standard is a value order v (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1, the type ValueStandardOrder, distinct from an end-realization order), and the conclusion is stated for its relation by explicit projection. By excluded middle and the loss bridge, phi favours x over y wherever x is better than y; by excluded middle and the arbitrariness bridge, phi favours x over y only where x is better than y. Betterness varies within an end-realization class: some x is better than y at s, at least one of them not a present input, and not at a scenario t that agrees with s on end-realization. Then phi favours x over y at s and not at t, so phi depends on betterness with end-realization fixed and is good-general. The argument uses neither the #2153 admissible family nor joint compossibility, root-profile admissibility, pure admissibility, the structural L, the purity of good-generality e2357adc or one-favouring realization 3e6ae3e7; nor the #2153 E premise. It is a conditional alternative formulation inside the purity family: its two bridges are the precise, value-relative form of the rationale recorded for e2357adc, so it shares that rationale and adds no independent warrant, and the bearer-level uniqueness that 3e6ae3e7 supplied to horn A is absorbed by the bridges (actualRootHasOneFavouringFromStandard, Lean-only). On this route alone the variation premise is bare; horn A's premises entail it (hornAPremisesGiveVariation). The main theorem uses no axioms. Comparator companions (Mathlib axioms): standardControls gives, on the #2153 two-being carrier with the Lane 2b profiles, a positive witness and for each non-logical premise a row where it fails, the others hold and the conclusion fails; its last row has a value order whose relation coincides with the end-realization ordering (betterness factors through end-realization), where the D-directed favouring is pure and tracks it and the variation premise fails. standardRelativity shows that the D-directed and good-tracking profiles agree in every genuine scenario except on c over d at cBetter, so the value bridges condemn the first and the D bridges the second at the same verdict. refinementCondemnsGoodTracking shows that a value-free refinement criterion would count the good-tracking profile itself as restricted. The assignments say nothing about what favouring, purity or value are.

LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
